# A Stair of Her Own

*Brakka dreams of carving the first new stairway down the cliff in a hundred years. Bring her 25 Dark Bark for her trial wedges, and look at the bare cliff on the Long Ridge where the stair's rock comes out of the mountain.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |

## Objectives

- Bring 25 [Dark Bark](../items/dark_bark.md) (taken)
- Look at the bare cliff in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)

- 6,300 EXP
- 440 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- [Blue Potion](../items/blue_potion.md) x10
